titulo: Review and final exam: The most common mistakes

aula.objetivo: Review the alphabet, gender, agreement, the basic cases, the present and the past tense, and take the final exam of the beginner level.

blocos.titulo: The 10 most common mistakes of English speakers
blocos.explicacao: These ten mistakes appear most often among English speakers. Fixing only these already makes your speech much more natural. Read each pair out loud: first the wrong one (to recognise the odd sound), then the right one (to fix it in memory).

erros.motivo: No «есть» in the present to say "is". (English forces you to say "it is"; Russian does not.)
The possessive agrees with the gender. (English "my" never changes.)
The direct object takes the accusative.
The double negative is compulsory in Russian.
The person who needs goes into the dative.
A question is made by intonation, with no «есть».

blocos.enunciado: Read each mistake out loud and say the correct form. Then record 5 sentences of your own, without any of these mistakes.
Write 3 mistakes you have made in Russian, with the correct form.
